scenes.title: Go to a New Land
beats: Long ago, God spoke to a man named Abraham. “Leave your home and go to a land I will show you. I will bless you, and through you I will bless the whole world.”
So Abraham packed up everything — his wife Sarah, his flocks, his tents — and set out, trusting God, even though he didn’t know where he was going.

layers.prompt: A long caravan crosses golden desert hills in the morning: Abraham leads the way with his staff, right of center, with Sarah riding a camel behind him, servants, rolled tents on donkeys, and flocks of sheep and goats

scenes.title: Count the Stars
beats: Abraham and Sarah were very old, and they had no children. One night God said, “Look up at the sky and count the stars — if you can!”
“That’s how many people will be in your family!” And Abraham believed God.

layers.prompt: Outside a tent on a hillside at night under a vast, glittering sky full of countless stars: old Abraham stands looking up in wonder, right of center, arms open wide

touch.hint: Tap the sky to add a star

scenes.title: Three Visitors
beats: One hot day, three visitors came to Abraham’s tent. Abraham hurried to give them water to wash with and a delicious meal.
“This time next year,” one said, “Sarah will have a son!” Sarah, listening inside the tent, laughed. She was ninety years old!
“Is anything too hard for the Lord?” the visitor asked.

layers.prompt: Under a great oak tree beside a big striped tent in the heat of the day, the scene filling the whole picture: Abraham welcomes three kind travelers with gentle smiling faces and uncovered heads, wearing flowing white and cream robes, right of center, offering them bread and milk, while Sarah peeks out from the tent door. No book, no page, no frame

scenes.title: A Baby Called Laughter
beats: And God kept His promise. Sarah had a baby boy, just as God said!
They named him Isaac, which means “he laughs.” “God has made me laugh,” said Sarah, “and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me!”

layers.prompt: Inside a cozy tent lit by oil lamps: Sarah, overjoyed, holds her newborn baby boy, right of center, while Abraham leans close, laughing with happiness

touch.hint: Tap to sing to the baby
